name: Hearts of the Pure
summary: In the Undercity, Godrick Farsan sets a trial for Carendin Halgar’s succubus binding. You seek two righteous human men whose pure hearts will tempt a demon.

sections.title: Bait for a Demon
sections.body: Carendin Halgar, master summoner in the Temple of the Damned, gives Godrick Farsan the groundwork for binding a succubus. Succubi prey on desire and ruin. Yet untainted virtue draws them from the Twisting Nether, where they are ripe for corruption. So Godrick searches human lands for souls whose goodness remains pristine and unbroken.

sections.title: The Quarry
sections.body: Godrick Farsan names two men whose virtue marks them for sacrifice. Dalin Forgewright cares for desperate Lordaeron refugees barred from sanctuary outside the sealed Greymane Wall in southern Silverpine. Comar Villard tirelessly searches the perilous marshlands of the Wetlands for any trace of his lost wife. Their devotion, empathy and loyalty make them prime sacrifices to a Forsaken warlock.

sections.title: A Forsaken Perspective
sections.body: You hunt both men through dangerous Alliance-held and wild territories, then butcher them. When you return their bloody hearts to the Temple of the Damned, Carendin Halgar observes that a good man’s heart looks no different from any other corpse’s remains. Yet the spiritual purity clinging to their flesh is potent bait, enough to lure a succubus into captivity.

faq.q: Why do warlocks need pure hearts to summon a succubus?
faq.answer: Succubi are drawn to mortal innocence and virtue, which they seek to corrupt. Carendin Halgar uses the hearts of genuinely pure and selfless men as irresistible spiritual bait to draw one across the Nether and trap her in a binding circle.

Dalin Forgewright is an honorable human who patrols on horseback along the closed gates of the Greymane Wall in southern Silverpine Forest. He devotes his life to caring for and protecting Lordaeron refugees rejected and shut out by Gilneas.
Comar Villard is a devoted human searching the northern road of the Wetlands, just south of the Thandol Span. Grief and steadfast love drive him to keep seeking any trace of his missing wife.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain lead?
faq.answer: Delivering the two hearts to Carendin Halgar lets him prepare the summoning circle in the Temple of the Damned. From there, you summon and subdue a succubus to serve as a permanent minion.

aliases: who starts hearts of the pure
faq.answer: Godrick Farsan, an assistant in the Temple of the Damned in the Undercity’s Magic Quarter, gives the assignment on Carendin Halgar’s behalf. He projects magical illusions of Dalin and Comar to show you whom to hunt.

faq.q: Why does Carendin Halgar dismiss the appearance of the hearts?
faq.answer: Carendin Halgar says a good man’s heart looks much like any other slab of flesh. As an Undead practitioner of the dark arts, he cares for its use as a magical reagent, not its physical morality.

angles.text: As a warlock, you learn to wield the nobility of others to bind demons to your will, along with misery and fear.
As an Undead, you see the Forsaken’s chilling view of Lordaeron’s survivors and their virtues as fitting material for ritual slaughter.
As an Alliance member, you know the victims as tragic human figures: one guards refugees shut out by Gilneas, while the other searches the marshlands for his lost wife.
